title: Upper limb · online exam screenshots (19 distinct prompts)
note: Two shuffled Golestan University screenshot exports (not verified TUMS finals), consolidated by distinct prompt. One extra quadrangular-space item survives only in the alternate export. questions.prompt: Fracture of surgical neck of humerus risks which nerve?
questions.note: Axillary nerve is closely related to surgical neck.
questions.subject: anatomy

questions.prompt: Second distal-row carpal from lateral side is:
questions.note: Distal row: trapezium, trapezoid, capitate, hamate.

questions.prompt: Which artery is medial to biceps tendon in cubital fossa?
questions.note: Brachial lies between tendon and median nerve.

questions.prompt: Which muscle arises from an FDP tendon?
questions.note: Lumbricals arise from FDP; duplicated distractor is preserved.
questions.subject: anatomy

questions.prompt: Which is a hinge synovial joint?
questions.note: Elbow is hinge; radioulnar pivot and MCP condyloid.
